'''Gilda''' is a serving maid in the [[Queen's Blessing]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Gilda}}

==Activities==

She warns [[Master Gill]] about [[Whitecloaks]] in the common room and of [[Moiraine|Moiraine's]] arrival at the inn.{{ref/book|1|41}}

Basel plans to pass on some rumors to her, confident they will spread all over Caemlyn in no time.{{ref/book|3|47}}
